versions.content: The Dem shall provide a function Dem_GetDebouncin- gOfEvent () that reports the debounce status of an event. The outparameter `De- bouncingState' returns the debouncing incl. intermediate states. One particular OBD specific bit shall support the DTR update trigger if test is complete and debouncing is at its limit while the enable and storage conditions are met.
